{{Quote|Get him! Get him!|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to the crowd urging them to help this [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
An '''Ithorian''' was attacked by a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] while attending the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]]. He was injured in the leg. Luckily, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] killed the nexu, and people near him rescued him from the nexu's jaws.
